en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall wooden lookout / observation tower rising above trees. The tower has an octagonal upper structure with open viewing galleries and a small lantern-like top platform with railings. At the base is a two‑storey wooden building with wrap‑around verandas and decorative railings, with several people standing or sitting on the porch and on the ground. The caption at the bottom gives the name and location of the tower in multiple languages.
